stage: U1-video input-video-only visible fitting upper-bound check

statistics.PSNR: poolfloat64SSE/(3validpixels), then -10log10; independently per scene/focus, each aperture also reported
statistics.patch_pool: whole unmasked fixed64px grid weighted by regional pixel support
statistics.RGB: standard displayRGBfloat[0,1];raw linearEXR retained;3D integrates true linearRGB
statistics.full_image: all pixels including sky and peeled-reference residuals

band.definition: 3x3 relative inverse-depth jump, union of max-local-CoC1.5x footprints; exclusively target current visible depth
band.primary_evaluation: band excluding previously flagged peeled-reference residual pixels;band itself is never GT-filtered
band.report: independent disocclusionGT recall/precision/FP/FN, unknownGT support and CoC distribution; no tuning toGT recall

quality.direction: PSNRgain>0 AND LPIPSchange<-3noise;absLPIPSchange<=3noise is tie,not direction improvement or significant deterioration
quality.guardrails: per-focus pooled full-image and in-focus PSNR versusO3 each drop<=0.2dB; individual cases also reported

high_light_influence.definition: max_RGB abs(S(Cycles_linear)-R_LDR)>0.02 in displayRGB; no dilation
high_light_influence.report: imagefraction,counts,spatial heatmap/connectedcomponent distribution and overlapwith frozen scoringregions;also influenced/uninfluenced scores
high_light_influence.not_pure_light_ground_truth: difference also includes finiteK andMC noise;not used to selectmethod content

reuse_frame1.reason: fixed predetermined final budget;not heldout-selected;old overfit decision remains inhistorical record

R2.stopping: historicalbest includesinitial monitor;stop ifheldoutPSNR <=best_seen-0.5dB for3 consecutive monitors OR any nonfinite loss/optimization value;train-minus-heldout gap reportedonly
R2.final_selection: fixed step8000 only ifstop rule nottriggered;never select checkpoint byheldout

methods.U1: learned nonnegative radiance,may>1, fixed sameband O6-GT-rec hidden,Cfill,K64
methods.U1_clip: same fitted visible Gaussians butclip visible linear colors[0,1] before rendering;hidden unchanged
methods.controls: sameoptimized visible without hidden for eachcolor mode;O3 andunoptimized L2

noise.source: L1 preregistered band-weighted independent Cycles pairs at frames1/30;maximum corresponding lens pair used forframe60

Cycles.worth_training: at least onefocus passes formal_method_value AND pooled full-image PSNR gain overO3>=0.5dB AND full-image LPIPS not worse beyond3noise

full_noise_source.rule: absolute difference <=3 times maximum independent-pair whole-image patch LPIPS at same lens and formal B2 SPP, frames1/30; frame60 uses maximum; existing B2 noise record only

LDR.criteria: same form asoriginal U1, new per-region max-pair reference noise
LDR.worth_training: atleast onefocus passes formalvalue AND full-image gain>=0.5dB versusO3 AND full-image LPIPS worsening<=3newfullnoise

R2.radiance_analysis: fraction anyRGB>1,projected spatialdensity;fraction/enrichment within3px (7x7dilation) of inputEXR pixels anyRGB>1;analysis only,not supervision

references.Cycles: unchanged B2 complete-scene truth, evaluate learned nonnegative unbounded visible colors
references.LDR: unchanged R1 mean of individually clipped linear subviews; evaluate same visible colors clipped[0,1] before rendering
references.noise: same frozen R2 Cycles lens noise and R1 per-region max independent-pair LDR noise

formal_methods.primary: U1_video with fixed GT-rec hidden layer
formal_methods.full_video: same U1_video fitted visible + exact cached L3 retrieved hidden and shared L3 fill; GT geometry, separate same gates
formal_methods.control: same fitted visible with no hidden; not independently refitted
formal_methods.reuse: O3,L2,R2 U1/U1_clip predictions and scores, no recomputation of baseline predictions

worth_training: at least onefocus passes formal_method_value AND pooled full-image PSNR gain overO3>=0.5dB AND full-image LPIPS not worse beyond3noise

retention.formula: (MSE(method)-MSE(O3))/(MSE(R2_U1)-MSE(O3)) = MSE improvement over O3 divided by R2 improvement
retention.matching: Cycles uses original U1; LDR uses U1_clip; independently per region and nominal focus, pooled SSE/(3*pixels)
retention.do_not_report: R2 PSNR advantage <=0.2 dB OR R2 MSE improvement<=1e-8 OR empty region

optimization.initialization: exact R2 observed-sky V-G and FittedVisible class, same R2 inputs()
optimization.hidden: fixed original R2 GT-rec selected by union of four main-lens bands, same sparse Gaussian profile, no color optimization
optimization.stochastic_loss: sample one view by fixed categorical distribution each step, per-view normalize valid pixels; 0.8 displayRGB L1 +0.2(1-SSIM11sigma1.5); no LPIPS loss
optimization.target_loss: all target-frame pixels, same R2 loss, including dynamic content and observed-sky RGB
optimization.neighbor_loss: only static, in-frustum, high-alpha, explained-depth pixels; fixed initial mask intersect current detached depth/alpha consistency every use; SSIM windows must be fully valid

depth_consistency.initial_mask: render initial target visible+fixed hidden depth into each own GT camera, no score masks
depth_consistency.live_mask: detach rendered depth/alpha, recheck every sampled neighbor; loss cannot differentiate through mask

dynamic_exclusion.own_neighbor: own GT ID dynamic mask dilated2px; sky/no hit also excluded
dynamic_exclusion.projected_target: initial merged cloud rendered dynamic-contribution alpha >0.01, dilated2px; excluded even if target geometry overlaps static target-frame content

minimum_supervision.check: before optimization and every sampled view using live mask; failure stops whole trial without threshold relaxation

optimization.background: same fixed LaMa C_fill image and local background-depth extension; warp background through source camera using target-depth-plane intersections; remaining transmittance only

monitoring.train: target and all12 masked video views, report target and neighbor separately; gap vs heldout descriptive only
monitoring.heldout: same R2 16 light-aperture heldout views, all16; not part of loss, not checkpoint selection
monitoring.stopping: same R2: nonfinite loss/parameters or heldout PSNR >=0.5dB below historical best for3 consecutive monitors; save actual final only; stop and report without expanding
monitoring.selection: fixed step8000 only; no heldout-selected checkpoint

reporting.baseline: 12 relative camera centers in target coordinates, norm/lateral/axial and ratios to f1.4/f2 lens radii; not equal angular coverage
reporting.radiance: fraction any visible Gaussian RGB>1; parameters not physically certified radiance

limits: one controlled scene,3 target frames,6 groups/focus; no crossscene or temporal generalization
per-scene fit is upper proxy, not proof a feedforward network can attain it
GT depths/poses and dynamic IDs are Oracle inputs; primary additionally has real hidden GT-rec; full-video uses GT geometry
LDR reference measures capped-radiance consistency, not true highlights
No new Blender render,DA3 inference,feedforward training or old-result changes
